\part{Conformance frame}

\section{Purpose and claim discipline}

This specification translates the shared scientific contract into auditable
evidence obligations without naming or judging an implementation. A future
conformity claim shall name one immutable realization, the exact frozen
scientific-contract version, every owner-selected AO alternative and parameter,
the full validity domain, and the evidence bundle. A partial or aggregate pass
cannot erase a failed requirement, prediction, option consequence, or named-use
profile.

Conformity means that a realization implements the selected scientific
operator and product semantics within the selected envelope. Validation is a
separate evaluation of immutable FLT-owned profiles. Performance measurement,
readiness, and production are later layers. This draft supplies no result in
any layer.

\section{Required conformance-claim record}

Before evaluation, a claim record shall freeze the following fields. Missing
fields make the claim unavailable; evaluator faults make the attempt failed.

\begin{longtable}{p{0.24\linewidth}p{0.66\linewidth}}
\toprule
Field & Required content \\
\midrule
\endhead
Contract identity & \texttt{SCI-FLT-MATCHED v0.1}, shared-core digest, owner-
disposed contract digest, and supersession status. \\
Realization identity & Complete realization tuple from
Section~\ref{sec:definitions}, including parent class and state generation. \\
Owner dispositions & Exact alternatives and all numeric/profile parameters for
\texttt{AO-001} through \texttt{AO-006}; no inferred defaults. \\
Validity domain & Parent classes, WCS/frame, indexing, units, template and
state strata, support/boundary classes, rank/null regimes, and exclusions. \\
Comparator & Exact $N/D$ reference identity, covariance authority when any,
and response/state reconstruction identity. \\
Evidence identity & Immutable input, expected-result, observed-result,
environment, tool/procedure, tolerance, uncertainty, and provenance records. \\
Verdicts & Requirement-, prediction-, option-, and profile-level outcomes using
distinct \textsf{disabled}, \textsf{unavailable}, \textsf{failed},
\textsf{complete}, and \textsf{superseded} semantics. \\
Nonclaims & Explicit statement that conformity does not establish validation,
performance, readiness, production, or scientific authority. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\section{Evidence rules}

\begin{enumerate}
  \item Every comparison shall bind exact quantity, unit, coordinate and index,
  support, state, population, aggregation norm, tolerance, and missing-value
  rule before observing the result.
  \item Finite test sampling shall include a coverage or regularity argument
  that extends the observation to the declared validity domain. Unresolved
  output-affecting modes are failures or typed unavailability as specified by
  the selected option.
  \item Expected and observed results shall remain immutable and distinguish
  analytic identities, numerical comparisons, empirical sampling uncertainty,
  and profile-policy evaluation.
  \item A test oracle shall not use the same undocumented operation as the
  realization under test. Shared scientific inputs are allowed; shared hidden
  state is not.
  \item Unexpected errors, warnings that change scientific meaning, skipped
  required strata, and missing required data prevent a complete verdict.
  \item Passing evidence establishes only its named claim for its named
  realization and domain. It cannot select an AO option or broaden authority.
\end{enumerate}

\part{Engineering audit protocol}

\section{Conformance test families}
\label{sec:ct-families}

These are specification-level evidence families, not executed tests. Each
future realization shall instantiate all applicable families after the owner
selects the six option sets.

\begin{longtable}{p{0.18\linewidth}p{0.27\linewidth}p{0.45\linewidth}}
\toprule
ID & Scope & Minimum evidence and verdict rule \\
\midrule
\endhead
\CT{001} & Identity and authority closure & Freeze contract, realization,
selected AO, parent/template/state, units, validity, lifecycle, and provenance
identities. Any missing/mutable identity is unavailable; mismatch fails. \\
\CT{002} & Parent admission & Exercise observation and coadd admissions
separately; reject derived/JINC parents, missing coadd membership, changed
generation, and assumed commutation/state sharing. \\
\CT{003} & Template and units & Verify immutable materialization, scaling,
phase, anchor, sampling, lineage, $[\widehat A]=[m]/[t]$, rescaling law, and
rejection of target/NOI-member learning and unsupported flux/beam meaning. \\
\CT{004} & Exact operator and normalization & Compare $N$, $D$, $L$, amplitude,
and matching-template response with an independent exact oracle over the full
cover; test zero, negative, nonfinite, and nonreal $D$ failure routing. \\
\CT{005} & Support, boundaries, and nulls & Construct complete, eroded, filled,
missing, invalid, and null-confounded cases; require exact valid-domain and
support/null equality with no partial estimate or edge renormalization. \\
\CT{006} & Weighting option & Instantiate the selected \AO{001} population,
units, coefficients, rank/null, regularization, window/edge, response,
uncertainty, products, failure, and option-specific quantitative closure.
Test observation and coadd separately. \\
\CT{007} & Approximation envelope & Evaluate every selected \AO{002} metric,
state stratum, boundary/support class, response query, covariance projection,
coverage proof, and method/realization boundary. Report worst cases. \\
\CT{008} & Response & Verify $R_t=L_xt_y$, unit self-response, full off-
diagonal behavior, selected \AO{005} reconstruction/query contract, invariance
nonclaims, lineage, units, lifecycle, and unsupported-query rejection. \\
\CT{009} & State and NOI parity & Verify declare/learn-once inputs and
population, freeze, selected \AO{004} persistence/reconstruction, generation
immutability, successor behavior, identical compatible-NOI transformation, and
rejection of per-member relearning. \\
\CT{010} & Covariance and uncertainty & Where authorized, independently
propagate $LC_{\rm parent}L^{\mathsf T}$ and validate selected \AO{003}, units,
population, rank/null, calibration terms, omitted-mode labels, consumers, and
sampling uncertainty. Otherwise verify typed absence and no $D^{-1}$ claim. \\
\CT{011} & Products and lifecycle & Verify atomic signal membership, companion
independence, five lifecycle states, required/optional failure propagation,
immutability, supersession, no public unqualified intermediate, and exact
lineage closure. \\
\CT{012} & Profiles and actions & Instantiate selected \AO{006}; exhaust role
verdict/dependency/action combinations for PA, SA, SP, CU, NU, and FH; verify
versioning, aggregation nonconcealment, and VAL's evaluator-only role. \\
\CT{013} & FLT to FRUIT handoff & Verify all minimum FLT-side facts and selected
response/state queries are available without undocumented state; reject FRUIT
science or unsupported queries without changing the signal verdict. \\
\CT{014} & Exclusions and fail-closed selection & Attempt every excluded or
unselected route, automatic fallback, source interpretation, posterior/Wiener
meaning, convolution equivalence, and unsupported uncertainty claim; require
typed rejection with no substituted product. \\
\CT{015} & Claim-layer separation & Verify records distinguish scientific
authority, conformity, validation, achieved performance, readiness, and
production, and that no transition is inferred from another layer. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

\section{Prediction evidence patterns}

\begin{longtable}{p{0.23\linewidth}p{0.47\linewidth}p{0.20\linewidth}}

\Pred{008}--\Pred{010} & Authorized fixed-state ensembles, exact propagated

\Pred{011}--\Pred{013} & Mutation/supersession attempts and atomic failure

\Pred{014}--\Pred{017} & Template rescaling, noninvariant response probes,

\bottomrule

\section{Verdict aggregation}

A complete implementation-conformity verdict requires every applicable
requirement, prediction, selected-option consequence, edge-case rule, and
named-use action to be complete on the full declared domain. Unavailable is
not a pass. Failed is not unavailable. Disabled is not an attempted result.
Superseded evidence remains immutable and cannot substantiate a successor
unless the successor explicitly binds it and closes every changed fact.

Optional companions receive separate verdicts. A signal-level aggregate may
remain complete when an optional companion fails only if the selected FLT-owned
policy says that companion is not required. Profile aggregation follows the
selected \AO{006} alternative and always retains six distinct role verdicts.

\appendix
\section{Audit artifact minimums}

For each instantiated conformance test, retain: test-family ID; requirement,
prediction, AO, assumption, edge-case, and profile IDs; immutable realization
and comparator identities; input and expected-output identities; exact units,
coordinates, support, state, population, rank/null, and calibration facts;
procedure identity; environment-dependent facts; observed results; complete
metric arrays or lossless references; tolerances and aggregation; worst-case
locations/modes; sampling uncertainty; lifecycle transitions; verdict and
reason; and provenance. A summary without these closures is not conformance
evidence.

\section{Author-packet basis and firewall statement}

This draft used only the exact eight objects named by the approved author
packet. Links were provenance only and were not opened. No implementation,
configuration, schema, test, audit, validation, reduction, generated product,
history, neighboring package, external source, or model-memory source supplied
scientific content. The shared core is identical to the one imported by the
Scientific Rationale and Contract.
